description: This file contains Sass mixins for form validation styling, including state selectors, feedback, tooltips, and validation-specific control styles.

methods.name: form-validation-state-selector
methods.description: A mixin that defines styles based on the validation state ('valid' or 'invalid') to toggle visibility of feedback and tooltip elements.

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: A mixin that styles form controls and associated elements (feedback, tooltip) based on validation state, colors, icons, and focus styles.
